definitions.gloss: tour of visits; touring several countries
definitions.explanation: Visiting several countries or places one after another, especially an official tour by a head of state or minister.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歴訪|れきほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister makes a tour of Europe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東南|とうなん}アジア→東南アジア：16277_tounanajia⟧{歴訪|れきほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧⟦{帰国|きこく}した→帰国する：21786_kikokusuru⟧。
examples.english: He returned home after a tour of Southeast Asia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中東|ちゅうとう}→中東：17924_chuutou⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{国|こく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歴訪|れきほう}し、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The president toured three Middle Eastern countries and held talks with each country's leaders.

notes:
USAGE:
A news word for official tours, almost always by leaders and ministers. The places take ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歴訪|れきほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜か{国|こく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歴訪|れきほう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tour ~ countries
- {歴訪中|れきほうちゅう}: during the tour
- {歴訪先|れきほうさき}: the countries visited on a tour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧: a visit to one place; {歴訪|れきほう} is several visits in a row
